notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Clues.
description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Five Hundred Year Diary.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.
